name: C Programming
description: Build confidence with the fundamentals of C.

questions.prompt: Which header declares printf in C?
questions.explanation: The standard input/output header stdio.h declares printf.

questions.prompt: What is the index of the first element in a C array?

options.a: It depends on the array length

questions.explanation: C array indexing starts at zero.

questions.prompt: Which operator gives the remainder of integer division?
questions.explanation: The % operator computes the remainder for integer operands.

questions.prompt: Which loop checks its condition after executing its body?
questions.explanation: A do-while loop executes its body before testing the condition.

questions.prompt: Which symbol terminates a simple expression statement in C?
questions.explanation: A semicolon terminates an expression statement.

questions.prompt: What does the & operator do in the expression &value?
questions.explanation: The unary address-of operator returns the address of its operand.

questions.prompt: Which declaration creates an array of five integers?
questions.explanation: An array declarator uses square brackets with its element count.

questions.prompt: Which function compares two null-terminated strings?
questions.explanation: strcmp compares strings lexicographically; strlen measures length and strcpy copies.

name: C++
description: Explore the language of objects, types, and reusable ideas.

questions.prompt: Which keyword is used to declare a class?
questions.explanation: A class declaration starts with the class keyword.

questions.prompt: What is the default member access in a C++ class?
questions.explanation: Class members are private by default. Struct members are public by default.

questions.prompt: Which operator is the scope-resolution operator?
questions.explanation: The :: operator qualifies a name with its namespace or class scope.

questions.prompt: Which prefix is used in a destructor name?
questions.explanation: A destructor is named with a tilde followed by the class name.

questions.prompt: Which standard library container is a dynamically sized contiguous array?
questions.explanation: std::vector stores elements contiguously and can change its size.

questions.prompt: Which object is commonly used for standard output?
questions.explanation: std::cout is the standard output stream; std::cin is the input stream.

questions.prompt: Which keyword enables dynamic dispatch for a member function?
questions.explanation: A virtual member function can be dynamically dispatched through a base pointer or reference.

questions.prompt: Which declaration creates a reference to an existing integer x?
questions.explanation: The & in this declaration makes ref an lvalue reference to x.

name: Physics
description: Understand motion, energy, and the world around you.

questions.prompt: What is the SI unit of force?
questions.explanation: Force is measured in newtons; one newton is one kilogram metre per second squared.

questions.prompt: Which of these is a vector quantity?
questions.explanation: Velocity has both magnitude and direction.

questions.prompt: A body moves 100 metres in 20 seconds. What is its average speed?
questions.explanation: Average speed equals total distance divided by elapsed time: 100 / 20 = 5 m/s.

questions.prompt: What is the SI unit of electric current?
questions.explanation: The ampere is the SI base unit of electric current.

questions.prompt: What is the approximate acceleration due to gravity near Earth's surface?
questions.explanation: A commonly used approximate value near Earth's surface is 9.8 m/s^2; the actual value varies with location.

questions.prompt: Which expression describes acceleration?
questions.explanation: Average acceleration is the change in velocity divided by the time interval.

questions.prompt: Which law states that an object maintains uniform motion unless acted on by a net external force?
questions.explanation: Newton's first law describes inertia.

questions.prompt: What is the SI unit of energy?
questions.explanation: The joule measures energy. The watt measures the rate of energy transfer.

name: Chemistry
description: Discover the building blocks of matter.

questions.prompt: What is the chemical formula for water?
questions.explanation: A water molecule contains two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

questions.prompt: The atomic number of an element equals its number of what?
questions.explanation: The atomic number is the number of protons in the nucleus.

questions.prompt: What is the pH of pure water at 25 degrees Celsius, approximately?
questions.explanation: Pure water is neutral and has a pH close to 7 at 25 degrees Celsius.

questions.prompt: Which element has the chemical symbol Na?
questions.explanation: Na is the chemical symbol for sodium.

questions.prompt: What happens in a covalent bond?
questions.explanation: A covalent bond involves shared electron density between atoms.

questions.prompt: How many oxygen atoms are in one molecule of carbon dioxide (CO2)?
questions.explanation: The subscript 2 indicates two oxygen atoms.

questions.prompt: Which of these elements is a noble gas?
questions.explanation: Helium belongs to the noble gases in group 18.

questions.prompt: The modern periodic table is arranged primarily by increasing what?
questions.explanation: Elements are ordered by atomic number.

name: English
description: Practice the details that make communication clear.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence.

options.a: She goes to school every day.
options.b: She go to school every day.
options.c: She going to school every day.
options.d: She gone to school every day.

questions.explanation: In the simple present, a third-person singular subject takes goes.

questions.prompt: Which word is an antonym of ancient?
questions.explanation: Modern contrasts with ancient.

questions.prompt: Which word is closest in meaning to rapid?
questions.explanation: Rapid means fast or happening at great speed.

questions.prompt: What is the standard plural of child?
questions.explanation: Children is the irregular plural of child.

questions.prompt: What is the simple past tense of go?
questions.explanation: Went is the simple past tense; gone is the past participle.

questions.prompt: Which punctuation mark ends a direct question?
questions.explanation: A direct question normally ends with a question mark.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct article: I ate ___ apple.
questions.explanation: An is used before a word beginning with a vowel sound, such as apple.

questions.prompt: Which of these words is a personal pronoun?
questions.explanation: She is a personal pronoun used as a subject.
